description: Retained Teamwork compatibility adapter for Claude Code development; Teamwork 7.2's official support scope and release-qualification evidence are Codex-only.

interface.shortDescription: Retained Claude Code compatibility adapter for development use.
interface.longDescription: This retained Claude Code adapter is for compatibility maintenance and local development, not a Teamwork 7.2 supported or release-qualified platform. It keeps clear Claude Code work native and adds focused methods only when discussion, full Deep Research, unknown-cause debugging, executable planning, independent review, project setup, global refresh, exact-root document migration, or persistent convergence needs them. Explorer remains an internal local-evidence role, Reviewer covers plan review, and Writer maintains six typed project documents without exposing storage mechanics. Claude Code remains in control of tools and permissions.
defaultPrompt: Use $teamwork-collaborate to explore this decision with me and recommend a direction.
Use $teamwork-research to investigate this external question across primary sources.
Use $teamwork-debug to diagnose this unknown-cause failure before changing it.
